**Code Writer** (code interpreter)
```python
"""Plot daily 2026 year-to-date stock gains using Yahoo Finance closing prices."""

from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.dates as mdates
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.ticker import PercentFormatter
import pandas as pd

DIRECTORY = Path("/mnt/data")
TICKERS = ("NVDA", "MSFT", "AAPL", "GOOG")
COLORS = ("#007F65", "#245ABA", "#7750B4", "#BC5812")


def main():
    """Read the closing prices, calculate gains, and save the chart."""
    closes = pd.read_csv(
        DIRECTORY / "yahoo_finance_closes.csv", index_col="Date", parse_dates=True
    ).sort_index()
    baseline = closes.loc["2025-12-31"]
    gains = closes.loc["2026"].div(baseline).sub(1).mul(100)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 6), dpi=180)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.095, right=0.86, top=0.80, bottom=0.16)
    fig.text(0.095, 0.94, "2026 YTD stock gains", fontsize=24, weight="bold")
    last_day = gains.index[-1]
    fig.text(
        0.095, 0.895,
        f"Daily change from the Dec 31, 2025 close through {last_day:%b %d, %Y}",
        fontsize=11, color="#475569",
    )
    for ticker, color in zip(TICKERS, COLORS):
        values = gains[ticker]
        ax.plot(values.index, values, color=color, lw=1.8, label=ticker)
        ax.scatter(last_day, values.iloc[-1], color=color, s=24, zorder=4)
        ax.annotate(
            f"{ticker}  {values.iloc[-1]:+.1f}%",
            (last_day, values.iloc[-1]), xytext=(8, 0), textcoords="offset points",
            va="center", color=color, fontsize=9.5, weight="bold",
        )

    ax.axhline(0, color="#64748B", lw=0.9)
    ax.set(xlabel="Day", ylabel="YTD Gain %", xlim=(pd.Timestamp("2026-01-01"), last_day))
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.MonthLocator())
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%b"))
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(xmax=100, decimals=0))
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#E2E8F0", linewidth=0.8)
    ax.spines[["top", "right", "left"]].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#CBD5E1")
    ax.tick_params(length=0, pad=6, labelcolor="#334155")
    fig.text(0.095, 0.045, "Source: Yahoo Finance · adjusted closing prices",
             fontsize=9, color="#475569")

    assert len(gains) > 200 and gains.index.is_unique
    assert not gains.isna().any().any()
    assert {line.get_label() for line in ax.lines[:-1]} == set(TICKERS)
    assert (ax.get_xlabel(), ax.get_ylabel()) == ("Day", "YTD Gain %")
    fig.savefig(DIRECTORY / "ytd_stock_gains.png", facecolor="white")
    plt.close(fig)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

**Code Writer**
The plot shows daily YTD gains for NVDA, MSFT, AAPL, and GOOG through November 20, 2026, relative to their December 31, 2025 adjusted closing prices.

**Code Reviewer**
The non-empty plot shows daily 2026 YTD gains for NVDA, MSFT, AAPL, and GOOG through November 20. It uses the requested axis labels, `Day` and `YTD Gain %`, and is saved as `ytd_stock_gains.png`. The readable plotting code includes a module docstring and calculates gains from the saved Yahoo Finance closing prices using December 31, 2025 as the baseline.

Minor suggestion: Add a small right margin inside the axes so the final-day markers aren’t clipped.
